My new book, Crisis of the Common Good, comes out next week, May 26th. It's a story about America's crisis of connection and meaning, and how it led to Trump.

Click this link to join us at events along the tour, starting in Connecticut, New York, and DC. crisisofthecommongood.com/

Video
State party convention day! Welcome to Hartford, delegates!

But of course we can’t trust anything Trump says about the summit or anything else. 

Here he is saying two diametrically opposed things back to back about talks on Taiwan. One a lie and the other the truth - who knows which is which.

Trump also said Xi was a friend because Xi agreed with him that the Iran War was a good thing. 

Of course Xi thinks this! Because it’s weakening the U.S. and tying Iran and China closer together.

Trump seemed to confirm he made a quiet deal to sell more advanced AI chips to China. That’s a disaster that undermines our own high tech economy and gives China an advantage in the race for AI supremacy.

The question is: what happened in Beijing that we didn’t see? What promises did Trump make to Xi on chips or Taiwan? What deals did he make for himself?

It’s clear America got zilch. Even the meager promises Trump claimed weren’t confirmed by Xi (and thus probably aren’t real).
Private equity is beginning to buy up sports teams and leagues in Connecticut. I was in the north end of Hartford today talking about my bill to keep profit vultures out of kids sports.

I’m kicking off the book tour in my hometown of Wethersfield but my next stop is New York City. 

If you live in the area please join me and @katiecouric for a discussion about the crisis of the common good in America. RSVP here. checkout.square.site/merchan…

It's hard to keep track of Trump's corruption schemes, but here's the most dangerous one.

Trump is suing the federal government (himself!) for billions in payments (to himself!) and when the courts say no, he tells the parties (both him!) to settle.

Confusing? Let me explain.

Video

This week I introduced the Let Kids Play Act with @RepDeluzio to get private equity out of youth sports.

It's simple - kids sports should be about kids and what's best for them, not jacking up costs to make money for investors.

Video

A lesson on how to call their BS.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

GILLIBRAND: What is your record?! I don't want to just hear about what you don't like about the Biden administration

SCOTT TURNER: During the Biden administra--

GILLIBRAND: Stop talking about Biden! Talk about your record

TURNER: During the Biden administration--

GILLIBRAND: Oh my God!

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/atrupar/status/2054934934469382319#m

6/ The first Trump administration botched the early response to COVID-19 and we can't let it happen again. The administration needs to come to Congress and answer questions about their plan to make sure this virus is contained.

5/ And - Trump withdrew from the WHO (where we could work on a global response), eliminated the office for pandemic response, and is proposing a 30% cut to the CDC. The CDC has also been without a permanent director for nearly 8 months. This all leaves us so vulnerable.

4/ Again, I don't want to be alarmist. Maybe this virus can't spread like COVID. But we don't know enough about it and last year, the Trump Admin killed funding to study hantavirus – one of many drastic cuts to infectious disease research.
scientificamerican.com/artic…

3/ We know airline passengers were exposed to people who left the cruise early, but the CDC hasn’t said what they’ve done to get in contact with those people or even how many people they are monitoring for contact tracing. Are we tracking exposures?
apnews.com/article/hantaviru…

2/ After the WHO said they were investigating an outbreak, it took the CDC days to say anything publicly and that only came AFTER a news outlet reported Americans who were exposed on the cruise ship were back on U.S. soil.

Why was the response so slow?
medpagetoday.com/special-rep…

It's time to ask some questions about Trump's nonchalant response to the Hantavirus outbreak. 

1/ We hope this isn't another COVID. It looks less contagious. But the Admin needs to take it more seriously and address some big holes they created in our pandemic response system.
